6. REMOVE OUTBOARD AND INBOARD JOINT BOOTS

7. DISASSEMBLE INBOARD JOINT
(a) Using a screwdriver, remove the end plate from the inboard joint.

(b) Place matchmarks on the inboard joint and drive shaft.
